name: AD user offboard
packageArguments: Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON object, run on a domain controller. {"Users":"jdoe,asmith"} (Mode Report, the default) prints each account's before-state and changes nothing. {"Mode":"Disable","Users":"jdoe","Description":"Disabled by Relian 2026-11-19, left","TargetOu":"OU=Disabled Users,DC=example,DC=com"} writes a JSON backup to C:\Relian\Offboard\<date>\, disables the account, sets its Description, moves it only if the OU exists, then reads it back; any mismatch exits 1. Description defaults to "Disabled by Relian <date>". Domain, Enterprise and Schema Admins, built-in, break-glass and sync accounts and unknown accounts are refused. Never deletes, never removes group memberships, never touches mailboxes. One JSON line per account. Revoke sessions and run a directory sync separately.
